description: This file defines the JsonMatrixConverter object, which provides methods to serialize and deserialize Matrix objects (SparseMatrix and DenseMatrix) to and from JSON format within the Spark MLlib library.

classes.name: JsonMatrixConverter
classes.description: Object providing JSON serialization/deserialization for Matrix objects in Spark MLlib.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Parses a JSON string to create a Matrix object (SparseMatrix or DenseMatrix).

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts a Matrix object into its JSON string representation.
